instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: I'm against the rule that bans phones during breaks, too. I work at a warehouse during the day. At night, I go to evening high school. So I can't promise to stop all contact while I'm at school. Between classes, I get messages about my shifts. If I reply late, the work goes to someone else. Once, my workplace kept calling during class. I couldn't answer. Later, they told me it was a problem that they could not reach me. They almost cut my shifts, too. I want to graduate from this school. I also need money to give to my family. Now I can understand my classes. I don't want to choose between work and school. I promise to keep my phone at the bottom of my bag. I won't touch it during class. But before you decide, please hear how I work, too.
